$comment: alignment-overlay/1: An alignment overlay layer (g4sim S9, Section 17): shifts and small rotations of IR placements named by mother, template and copy number, applied to a detector-spec's IR by core/geometry/alignment.py; an applied overlay yields a new geometry_id.

source_of_facts.description: where the shifts come from (a survey, a track-based alignment), as a specification's source_of_facts

delta_mm.description: the shift of the placement's centre in its mother's frame, decimal strings

rotation.description: an active rotation about the placement's centre, Rz Ry Rx, applied after the placement's own
